Naz Hillmon has cleared 2+ rebounds in 91% of her 45 games this season, and is riding a 16-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 4.4 rebounds on the season (4 across her last 5) — the 2+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -650 at Fanatics.

Kiah Stokes has cleared 4+ rebounds in 84% of her 45 games this season, and is riding a 5-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 5.8 rebounds on the season (9 across her last 5) — the 4+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -650 at Fanatics.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -302 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
